name: Bead binding, ethanol wash and elution chip
description: Binds cDNA to magnetic beads, washes on the magnet and elutes the library. Parametric parts: modules bead_chamber use the nearest library block as a stand-in (real part and sizing in autochip_part / params). build_chip.py builds the stand-ins at library size; the exact chip needs the autochip layout stage.

modules.does: Beads bind the cDNA, are held by the magnet during two ethanol washes, then release the library into elution buffer.

off_chip.why: Library concentration and size measurement are done on the bench (fluorometer is not on the lab list).

steps_text.21: Bind the released cDNA to magnetic beads.
steps_text.22: Wash the beads on a magnet.
steps_text.23: Elute the library from the beads.
